learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 根据病史（无痛、无发热皮疹、逐年加重）、查体（除拇指拇趾外的指趾屈曲、关节挛缩）和反复阴性的炎症与自身抗体检查，区分非炎症性关节病与炎症性关节炎，并按ILAR分类标准（2004）说明JIA为何是排除性诊断。
learningOutcomes.en: Distinguish a non-inflammatory arthropathy from inflammatory arthritis using the history (painless, no fever or rash, worse every year), the examination (flexed fingers and toes sparing the thumbs and great toes, joint contractures) and repeatedly negative inflammatory and autoantibody tests, and explain from the ILAR classification (2004) why JIA is a diagnosis of exclusion.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 把心音稍钝伴心包摩擦音识别为心包受累、可能有积液的体征：当场在床旁评估有无心脏压塞（心率、血压、奇脉、呼吸、颈静脉），并按ESC 2025指南完成初始评估（超声心动图、心电图、胸片，以及肌钙蛋白、CRP、NT-proBNP等生物标志物），不等到门诊。
learningOutcomes.en: Recognise slightly muffled heart sounds with a pericardial rub as signs of pericardial involvement, possibly with fluid: check for tamponade at the bedside at once (heart rate, blood pressure, pulsus paradoxus, breathing, neck veins) and complete the initial assessment ESC 2025 recommends (echocardiography, ECG, chest X-ray and biomarkers — troponin, CRP, NT-proBNP) during this admission, not as an outpatient.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 对既未确立心脏压塞、也未确立心包炎症的中等量心包积液作出处理：不引流、不用抗炎药，请心脏科评估，做心脏磁共振并定期复查超声心动图，说明需要引流的指征（ESC 2025）。
learningOutcomes.en: Manage a moderate pericardial effusion in which neither tamponade nor pericardial inflammation is established: no drainage and no anti-inflammatory drugs, cardiology review with cardiac MRI and repeat echocardiography, and state the indications for drainage (ESC 2025).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 说出CACP综合征的组成、致病基因（PRG4）和遗传方式（常染色体隐性），区分临床诊断与分子诊断，并给家庭说明再发风险（父母都携带时每个孩子1/4）。
learningOutcomes.en: Name the features of CACP syndrome, its gene (PRG4) and its inheritance (autosomal recessive), separate a clinical from a molecular diagnosis, and give the family the recurrence risk (1 in 4 for each child when both parents carry a variant).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 为非炎症性的遗传性关节病制订计划：不用激素、甲氨蝶呤或生物制剂，安排康复、髋关节影像和骨科随访，并与心脏科共同随访。
learningOutcomes.en: Plan care for a non-inflammatory genetic arthropathy: no steroids, methotrexate or biologics; rehabilitation, hip imaging and orthopaedic follow-up, with shared cardiology follow-up.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 用孩子和家属听得懂的话解释工作诊断、尚未证实的部分和计划（Calgary–Cambridge；告知诊断时用SPIKES），回应对激素的担心，并用复述法确认理解。
learningOutcomes.en: Explain the working diagnosis, what is still unproven and the plan in words the boy and his relative understand (Calgary–Cambridge; SPIKES for the diagnosis), answer the worry about steroids, and check understanding with teach-back.

chiefComplaint.en: Multiple swollen joints for three years

triageNote.zh-CN: 9岁男孩，家属陪同入院，体重19.5 kg。家属说三年前发现他胳膊和腿上的关节肿，一年比一年重。请先听他们讲，再给他查体。
triageNote.en: 9-year-old boy admitted with a relative; weight 19.5 kg. The relative says the joints of his arms and legs were first seen to be swollen three years ago and have been worse every year. Please take the history, then examine him.

personality.en: Qinghe is 9, quiet and cooperative, and answers briefly when asked how he feels; the relative who brought him tells the story and wants to understand what this illness is.

speechStyle.zh-CN: 孩子说话简短、口语化；家属说话朴实，不用医学术语，化验只记得“血沉”“风湿”这几个词。
speechStyle.en: The boy speaks in short, everyday sentences; the relative speaks plainly, without medical terms, and remembers only words like “ESR” and “rheumatism” from the tests.

openingLine.zh-CN: （家属）大夫，他胳膊和腿上好几个关节都肿，三年前开始发现的，一年比一年重。
openingLine.en: (His relative) Doctor, several joints in his arms and legs are swollen. It was first noticed three years ago, and it's been worse every year.

fallbackUnknown.en: I'm not sure about that, doctor.

concerns.zh-CN: 肿了三年，查血沉、查风湿都说阴性，可一年比一年重——他到底是什么病？
concerns.en: Three years of swelling, the ESR and rheumatism tests were negative, and it's worse every year — what is wrong with him?

concerns.zh-CN: 会不会要用激素那种很厉害的药？
concerns.en: Will he need strong medicines like steroids?

actingNotes.zh-CN: 家属回答病史；直接问孩子本人的问题（关节疼不疼）由孩子回答：不疼，就是肿。家属知道的只有：三年前发现关节肿、逐年加重；刚开始活动不怎么受影响；没有关节疼痛、发热或皮疹；以前查过血沉和风湿方面的指标，都是阴性；没做过特别的治疗；父母不是近亲；家里没人得过类似的病；按程序打了预防针；没接触过结核病人；体重19.5公斤。其他事情（手指脚趾什么时候开始弯、早上僵不僵、有没有气短胸痛或容易累、眼睛、兄弟姐妹、出生和发育、以前的病和手术、受伤或出血、过敏、现在的日常活动）一律如实说不知道，不要编。不要提前说出检查结果、诊断或治疗。
actingNotes.en: The relative gives the history; questions put to the boy himself (do his joints hurt) he answers: no, they're just swollen. All the relative knows is: the joint swelling was noticed three years ago and has worsened every year; at first it hardly affected his moving; no joint pain, fever or rash; ESR and rheumatism tests were negative; no particular treatment; his parents are not related; nobody in the family has had a similar illness; vaccinations according to the schedule; no contact with tuberculosis; weight 19.5 kg. Everything else (when his fingers and toes began to bend, morning stiffness, breathlessness, chest pain or tiring, his eyes, brothers or sisters, birth and development, past illnesses and operations, injuries or bleeding, allergies, how he manages day to day now) is honestly not known — never invent it. Never anticipate results, the diagnosis or treatment.

dose.en: Ask a paediatric cardiologist to assess the effusion and agree the interval for repeat echocardiography and the triggers for drainage.

response.zh-CN: 已请儿童心脏科会诊。本病例没有记录心脏科会诊，也没有记录复查的超声心动图。
response.en: Paediatric cardiology asked to review him. This case records no cardiology review and no repeat echocardiogram.

name.zh-CN: 转介康复：物理治疗和作业治疗（关节活动度、肌力、日常活动，必要时支具）
name.en: Rehabilitation referral: physiotherapy and occupational therapy (range of motion, strength, daily activities, splints if needed)

dose.zh-CN: 转介康复团队：维持并改善关节活动度、肌力和日常生活能力，按需要为手指和关节挛缩配支具，教会家属在家练习。
dose.en: Refer to the rehabilitation team: maintain and improve range of motion, strength and daily function, splint the finger and joint contractures as needed, and teach the family a home programme.

response.zh-CN: 已转介康复团队评估并制订训练计划。
response.en: Referred to the rehabilitation team for assessment and a programme.

name.zh-CN: 转介临床遗传科：遗传咨询并安排基因检测
name.en: Clinical genetics referral: genetic counselling and gene testing

dose.zh-CN: 转介临床遗传科：解释检测能说明什么，取得同意后安排基因检测，结果出来后为家庭做遗传咨询。
dose.en: Refer to clinical genetics: explain what testing can show, arrange the gene test with consent, and counsel the family on the result.

response.zh-CN: 已转介临床遗传科。本病例没有记录遗传咨询，也没有记录任何基因检测结果。
response.en: Referred to clinical genetics. This case records no genetic counselling and no gene-test result.

name.zh-CN: 请儿童骨科评估髋关节和关节挛缩
name.en: Paediatric orthopaedic review of the hips and the contractures

dose.zh-CN: 请儿童骨科结合骨盆X线片评估髋关节和各关节的挛缩，制订随访计划。
dose.en: Ask paediatric orthopaedics to assess the hips, with a pelvic radiograph, and the joint contractures, and to plan follow-up.

response.zh-CN: 已请儿童骨科会诊。本病例没有记录骨科评估。
response.en: Paediatric orthopaedics asked to review him. This case records no orthopaedic assessment.

name.zh-CN: 与清和和家属谈：工作诊断、尚未证实的部分和下一步计划
name.en: Talk with Qinghe and his relative: the working diagnosis, what is still unproven and the plan

dose.zh-CN: 用通俗的话说明工作诊断、哪些还没有证实、关节和心脏的计划，回答他们的问题，并请他们用自己的话复述。
dose.en: In plain words: the working diagnosis, what is not yet proven, the plan for his joints and heart, and their questions — then ask them to say it back in their own words.

response.zh-CN: 已与清和和家属谈话。本病例没有记录与家属的谈话。
response.en: Conversation held with Qinghe and his relative. This case records no conversation with the family.

name.zh-CN: 床旁心包穿刺引流

dose.zh-CN: 床旁心包穿刺，留置引流管。
dose.en: Pericardial puncture at the bedside, leaving a drain in.

harm.zh-CN: 没有指征：没有任何记录能确立心脏压塞——他没有颈静脉怒张，也没有记录到血流动力学受影响；单凭心音稍钝不能诊断压塞，压塞是临床诊断，要由超声心动图证实。ESC 2025指南推荐在心脏压塞、怀疑细菌性或肿瘤性心包炎，或经药物治疗仍有症状的中到大量积液时，在超声、CT或X线透视引导下行心包穿刺（I类）——这些情况在他身上都没有确立。没有指征、没有影像引导的穿刺可刺伤心肌或冠状动脉，引起气胸和心律失常。
harm.en: No indication: nothing recorded establishes tamponade — his neck veins are not distended, no haemodynamic compromise is recorded, and slightly muffled heart sounds alone do not make the diagnosis, which is clinical and confirmed by echocardiography. ESC 2025 recommends pericardiocentesis, guided by echocardiography, CT or fluoroscopy, for cardiac tamponade, suspected bacterial or neoplastic pericarditis, or a symptomatic moderate-to-large effusion despite medical therapy (class I) — none of which is established for him. A needle without an indication or imaging guidance can lacerate the heart or a coronary artery and cause pneumothorax and arrhythmia.

response.zh-CN: 这是一次没有指征的有创操作（见安全提示）。本病例不模拟它的后果；本病例也没有记录任何心包穿刺或引流。
response.en: This is an invasive procedure without an indication (see the safety note). The case does not simulate its consequences, and it records no pericardial puncture or drainage.

name.zh-CN: 长期大剂量口服泼尼松龙（按炎症性关节炎处理）
name.en: Long-term high-dose oral prednisolone (as for inflammatory arthritis)

dose.zh-CN: 大剂量口服泼尼松龙，长期使用、缓慢减量。
dose.en: High-dose oral prednisolone, continued long term and tapered slowly.

harm.zh-CN: 激素治疗的是炎症；这里没有任何记录能确立炎症性关节炎——肿胀不疼，没有发热和皮疹——在原因明确之前用激素还会干扰诊断。长期激素会抑制生长、削弱骨骼、增加感染风险：ESC 2025不推荐在没有特定指征时把激素作为心包炎的首选治疗（III类），并指出儿童更要严格限制激素（生长受损）；即使是确诊的多关节型JIA，2026年ACR JIA指南也以改善病情药为一线治疗，并有条件地不建议把口服激素作为初始治疗的辅助用药。
harm.en: Steroids treat inflammation; nothing recorded here establishes an inflammatory arthritis — the swelling is painless, with no fever or rash — and a steroid started before the cause is known blurs the work-up. Long-term steroids impair growth, weaken bone and raise infection risk: ESC 2025 does not recommend corticosteroids as the first option for pericarditis without a specific indication (class III) and restricts them in children even more than in adults because of growth impairment, and even for established polyarticular JIA the 2026 ACR JIA guidelines make DMARDs the first-line therapy and conditionally recommend against oral glucocorticoids as an adjunct to initial therapy.

response.zh-CN: 已开始激素治疗（见安全提示）。本病例不模拟它的作用。
response.en: Steroid treatment started (see the safety note). The case does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 每周甲氨蝶呤（按多关节型JIA处理）

dose.zh-CN: 甲氨蝶呤每周一次，按多关节型JIA起始。
dose.en: Methotrexate once a week, started as for polyarticular JIA.

harm.zh-CN: 甲氨蝶呤是炎症性关节炎的改善病情药（2026年ACR JIA指南把它作为多关节型JIA首选的传统改善病情药），而按ILAR分类标准（2001年修订、2004年发表），JIA只能在排除其他已知病因后诊断。在炎症性关节炎没有确立时用药，会带来肝毒性、骨髓抑制和感染风险，却没有可以期待的获益。
harm.en: Methotrexate is a disease-modifying drug for inflammatory arthritis (for polyarticular JIA, the first conventional DMARD in the 2026 ACR JIA guidelines), and JIA can be diagnosed only after other known causes are excluded (ILAR, Edmonton 2001, published 2004). Started before an inflammatory arthritis is established, it brings liver toxicity, marrow suppression and infection risk without an expected benefit.

response.zh-CN: 已开始甲氨蝶呤（见安全提示）。本病例不模拟它的作用。
response.en: Methotrexate started (see the safety note). The case does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: TNF抑制剂（依那西普或阿达木单抗）

dose.zh-CN: 皮下注射TNF抑制剂（依那西普或阿达木单抗）。
dose.en: A subcutaneous TNF inhibitor (etanercept or adalimumab).

harm.zh-CN: 2026年ACR JIA指南把生物制剂（首选TNF抑制剂）用于确诊的多关节型JIA；这里炎症性关节炎没有确立（ILAR，2004：先排除其他病因）。TNF抑制剂带来严重感染（包括结核再激活）的风险，却没有可以期待的获益。
harm.en: The 2026 ACR JIA guidelines use biologics (a TNF inhibitor first) to treat established polyarticular JIA; no inflammatory arthritis is established here (ILAR 2004: other causes first). A TNF inhibitor brings a risk of serious infection, including tuberculosis reactivation, without an expected benefit.

response.zh-CN: 已用TNF抑制剂（见安全提示）。本病例不模拟它的作用。
response.en: TNF inhibitor given (see the safety note). The case does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 膝关节腔内注射曲安奈德

dose.zh-CN: 膝关节腔内注射曲安奈德（必要时在镇静下进行）。
dose.en: Intra-articular triamcinolone into the knees (under sedation if needed).

harm.zh-CN: 关节腔内注射激素是炎症性关节炎的辅助治疗（对多关节型JIA，2026年ACR JIA指南有条件地推荐它作为初始治疗的辅助）；这里炎症性关节炎没有确立，注射需要镇静、有关节感染风险，却没有可以期待的获益。
harm.en: Intra-articular steroid is an adjunct treatment for inflammatory arthritis (for polyarticular JIA the 2026 ACR JIA guidelines conditionally recommend it as an adjunct to initial therapy); with no inflammatory arthritis established it adds sedation and a risk of joint infection without an expected benefit.

response.zh-CN: 已做关节腔注射（见安全提示）。本病例不模拟它的作用。
response.en: Joint injections done (see the safety note). The case does not simulate their effect.

name.zh-CN: 按急性心包炎给大剂量NSAID或阿司匹林，加秋水仙碱
name.en: High-dose NSAID or aspirin, plus colchicine, as for acute pericarditis

dose.zh-CN: 布洛芬（大剂量，按体重给药）或阿司匹林，加秋水仙碱，用数周至数月。
dose.en: Ibuprofen (high dose, by weight) or aspirin, plus colchicine, for weeks to months.

harm.zh-CN: ESC 2025：心包摩擦音只是心包炎的附加标准之一，确诊心包炎要有临床表现（如心包炎样胸痛），并有超过一项（即至少两项）附加标准；他没有记录到胸痛。积液应尽量针对病因治疗；没有心包炎症（既没有CRP升高，影像上也没有炎症证据）时不推荐抗炎治疗（第11.7.4节）——先查炎症指标、做心脏超声。在心包情况和病因评估清楚之前就开数周到数月的NSAID或阿司匹林加秋水仙碱，会带来胃肠和肾脏不良反应，却没有可以期待的获益；而且多数儿科医生在儿童中避免使用阿司匹林（ESC 2025第12.2.2节）。
harm.en: ESC 2025: a pericardial rub is one additional criterion; a definite diagnosis of pericarditis needs a clinical presentation (such as pericarditic chest pain) with more than one additional criterion, and no chest pain is recorded for him. Treat an effusion's cause wherever possible; without pericardial inflammation (no raised CRP and no imaging evidence of inflammation) anti-inflammatory treatment is not recommended (section 11.7.4) — check the inflammatory markers and image the heart first. Weeks to months of NSAID or aspirin with colchicine before the pericardium and the cause are assessed bring gastrointestinal and renal adverse effects without an expected benefit, and most paediatricians avoid aspirin in children (ESC 2025, section 12.2.2).

response.zh-CN: 已开始抗炎药和秋水仙碱（见安全提示）。本病例不模拟它们的作用。
response.en: Anti-inflammatory drug and colchicine started (see the safety note). The case does not simulate their effect.

hint.zh-CN: 问清肿胀从什么时候开始、怎样变化、疼不疼，有没有发热和皮疹，以前查过什么、治过什么，还有家里的情况；也问问他们可能答不上来的事。
hint.en: Ask when the swelling began and how it has changed, whether it hurts, about fevers and rashes, earlier tests and treatment, and the family — and ask about what they may not know.

guidance.zh-CN: 家属回答病史；问孩子本人的问题，他会自己回答。
guidance.en: His relative gives the history; questions put to the boy himself he answers.

title.en: Examine him from his fingers to his heart

hint.zh-CN: 看手指、脚趾和大关节，再听心脏、看颈静脉。
hint.en: Look at his fingers, toes and large joints, then listen to his heart and look at his neck veins.

title.zh-CN: 定下入院当天要做的事
title.en: Decide what he needs on day one

hint.zh-CN: 心脏听诊发现了什么、说明什么？今天他需要哪项检查？在床旁怎样判断他是否安全？
hint.en: What does the heart examination tell you? Which test does he need today, and how do you judge at the bedside whether he is safe?

guidance.zh-CN: 入院当天，关节的问题之外还有心脏的发现。
guidance.en: Day of admission: besides his joints, there is a finding at his heart.

title.zh-CN: 把检查结果放在一起看

hint.zh-CN: 调阅血液检查和关节影像，再看超声心动图：哪些支持炎症，哪些不支持？他的心脏现在需要怎么处理？
hint.en: Read the blood tests and the joint imaging alongside the echocardiogram: what supports inflammation and what does not? What does his heart need now?

guidance.zh-CN: 现在可以调阅他的检查记录。
guidance.en: His test records can now be read.

title.en: Check the diagnosis and plan ahead

hint.zh-CN: 这个诊断靠什么成立、还缺什么？家属会有问题要问；他的关节和心脏以后谁来管、怎么管？
hint.en: What does this diagnosis rest on, and what is missing? The family will have questions; who will look after his joints and heart, and how?

guidance.en: The team has made its diagnosis.

title.zh-CN: 对照原报告的处理与随访
title.en: Compare with the report's treatment and follow-up

hint.zh-CN: 决策都完成后，原报告的处理和随访记录会打开；把它和你的计划比一比。
hint.en: Once every decision is made, the report's treatment and follow-up record opens; compare it with your plan.

prompt.zh-CN: 入院查体：心音稍钝，心前区可闻及心包摩擦音，无颈静脉怒张。他的心脏，今天怎么处理？
prompt.en: On admission his heart sounds are slightly muffled, with a pericardial friction rub over the precordium, and his neck veins are not distended. What do you do about his heart today?

need.zh-CN: 先听诊心脏，并看颈静脉。
need.en: Listen to his heart and look at his neck veins first.

text.zh-CN: 今天做超声心动图和心电图；现在就查心率、血压、奇脉、呼吸和颈静脉，并定时复查；暂不用抗炎药或激素。
text.en: Echocardiography and an ECG today, with heart rate, blood pressure, pulsus paradoxus, breathing and neck veins checked now and repeated regularly; no anti-inflammatory or steroid yet.

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。心音稍钝加心包摩擦音提示心包受累，可能已有积液。ESC 2025建议，所有怀疑心包炎的患者都要做完整的初始评估——病史、查体、胸片、生物标志物、心电图和超声心动图（I类）；超声心动图是发现和测量积液、判断血流动力学影响以及随访的主要工具。心脏压塞是临床诊断：积液缓慢积聚时Beck三联征可以缺如，没有颈静脉怒张不能排除，要结合心率、血压和奇脉，并由超声证实。
feedback.en: Right. Slightly muffled heart sounds with a rub point to pericardial involvement, possibly with fluid. ESC 2025 recommends a complete initial evaluation — history, examination, chest X-ray, biomarkers, ECG and echocardiography (class I) — for everyone with suspected pericarditis, and echocardiography is the main tool to find and size an effusion, judge its haemodynamic effect and follow it. Tamponade is a clinical diagnosis: Beck's triad may be missing when fluid gathers slowly, so neck veins that are not distended do not exclude it — add heart rate, blood pressure and pulsus paradoxus, with echo confirmation.

text.zh-CN: 按急性心包炎先开大剂量NSAID加秋水仙碱，并限制剧烈活动；一周后摩擦音和症状仍不消失，再申请超声心动图。
text.en: Treat it as acute pericarditis first: high-dose NSAID plus colchicine and no strenuous activity, requesting echocardiography only if the rub and symptoms have not settled after a week.

feedback.zh-CN: 先治疗、后成像，顺序颠倒了。ESC 2025要求怀疑心包炎时先做包括超声心动图在内的完整评估，有没有积液、积液多少以及对心脏的影响决定下一步；没有心包炎症证据（CRP不高、影像上也没有炎症）时不推荐抗炎治疗，积液要针对病因处理。
feedback.en: Treatment before imaging is the wrong order. ESC 2025 asks for a complete evaluation including echocardiography first when pericarditis is suspected, and whether there is an effusion, its size and its effect decide what follows; without evidence of pericardial inflammation (no raised CRP and none on imaging) it does not recommend anti-inflammatory treatment, and an effusion is treated by its cause.

text.zh-CN: 摩擦音加心音稍钝说明积液已经不少，今天就在床旁做心包穿刺引流，同时把积液送检找原因，免得夜里发生心脏压塞。
text.en: A rub with slightly muffled heart sounds means a sizeable effusion: drain it today by bedside pericardiocentesis and send the fluid to find the cause, before tamponade develops overnight.

feedback.zh-CN: 没有穿刺指征：心脏压塞是临床诊断，要由超声心动图证实，而目前没有任何记录能确立它——他没有颈静脉怒张，单凭心音稍钝不能诊断压塞；要等影像显示有指征时才考虑穿刺。ESC 2025推荐影像引导下心包穿刺的情况是心脏压塞、怀疑细菌性或肿瘤性心包炎，或经药物治疗仍有症状的中到大量积液——这些在他身上都没有确立；盲目穿刺可能刺伤心肌或冠状动脉。
feedback.en: No indication for a needle: tamponade is a clinical diagnosis confirmed by echocardiography, and nothing recorded establishes it — his neck veins are not distended, and slightly muffled heart sounds alone do not make it; a needle waits until imaging shows an indication. ESC 2025 recommends image-guided pericardiocentesis for tamponade, suspected bacterial or neoplastic pericarditis, or a symptomatic moderate-to-large effusion despite medical therapy — none of which is established for him; a blind needle can lacerate the heart or a coronary artery.

text.zh-CN: 多处关节肿胀又有心包受累，像全身型JIA的浆膜炎：今天就开始静脉甲泼尼龙冲击来保护心脏，等炎症控制以后再做超声心动图和心电图。
text.en: Several swollen joints with pericardial involvement look like the serositis of systemic JIA: start IV methylprednisolone pulses today to protect the heart, and arrange echocardiography and an ECG once the inflammation has settled.

feedback.zh-CN: 全身型JIA要求关节炎伴有（或之前有）持续至少两周的发热，其中至少3天记录为每日发热，并有一过性皮疹、全身淋巴结肿大、肝脾大或浆膜炎之一（ILAR 2004）；他没有发热，也没有皮疹。原因不明、心脏还没有做超声就用激素，会掩盖病情、延误诊断；ESC 2025还指出，儿童更要严格限制激素（生长受损）。
feedback.en: Systemic JIA needs arthritis with, or preceded by, fever of at least two weeks documented as daily for at least three days, plus one of an evanescent rash, generalised lymph node enlargement, hepatomegaly or splenomegaly, or serositis (ILAR 2004); he has no fever and no rash. Steroids given before the cause is known and the heart imaged mask the picture and delay the diagnosis, and ESC 2025 restricts corticosteroids in children even more than in adults because of growth impairment.

text.zh-CN: 他的关节不疼、颈静脉不怒张，情况稳定：先处理关节的问题，超声心动图安排在几周后门诊做，到时再复查摩擦音。
text.en: His joints don't hurt and his neck veins are not distended, so he is stable: sort out the joints first, book an outpatient echocardiogram in a few weeks and recheck the rub then.

feedback.zh-CN: 心音稍钝加心包摩擦音，这次住院就要做超声心动图，看有没有积液、有多少，并判断有没有压塞：ESC 2025建议所有怀疑心包炎的患者在初始评估时就做超声心动图。颈静脉不怒张不能排除压塞：缓慢积聚的积液可以积得很多，ESC 2025称压塞是“最后一滴”现象，再多一点就可能失代偿。
feedback.en: Slightly muffled heart sounds with a rub need echocardiography during this admission to look for fluid, size it and look for tamponade: ESC 2025 recommends it in the initial assessment of everyone with suspected pericarditis. Neck veins that are not distended do not exclude tamponade: a slowly gathering effusion can grow large, and ESC 2025 calls tamponade a last-drop phenomenon — a little more fluid can tip him over.

prompt.zh-CN: 超声心动图：中等量心包积液，左室收缩功能正常。他没有颈静脉怒张，血沉和CRP反复阴性。这个积液下一步怎么办？
prompt.en: Echocardiography: a moderate pericardial effusion with normal left ventricular systolic function. His neck veins are not distended, and his ESR and CRP have been repeatedly negative. What is the plan for the effusion?

need.zh-CN: 先看超声心动图和炎症指标记录。
need.en: Read the echocardiogram and the inflammatory markers record first.

text.zh-CN: 暂不引流：继续观察压塞表现；请儿童心脏科评估，做心脏磁共振，定期复查超声心动图并找原因；出现压塞、治疗后仍有症状或疑有感染、肿瘤时再引流。
text.en: No drainage: keep checking for tamponade; paediatric cardiology review, cardiac MRI and repeat echoes at set intervals while the cause is sought; drain only for tamponade, symptoms despite treatment, or suspected infection or cancer.

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。ESC 2025：积液的治疗应尽量针对病因；没有心包炎症（CRP不高、影像无炎症证据）时不推荐抗炎治疗；推荐心包穿刺的情况是心脏压塞、怀疑细菌性或肿瘤性心包炎，或经药物治疗仍有症状的中到大量积液；怀疑心包炎而临床标准不能确诊时，推荐做心脏磁共振（I类），看心包有无增厚、水肿和延迟强化。随访主要看症状、超声心动图上积液大小的变化和血流动力学，以及CRP；若没有症状，至少中等量的积液合理的随访间隔约为6个月，最好在专科中心，出现气短、乏力或胸痛时要及时就诊。
feedback.en: Right. ESC 2025: treat an effusion's cause wherever possible; without pericardial inflammation (no raised CRP, no inflammation on imaging) anti-inflammatory treatment is not recommended; pericardiocentesis is recommended for tamponade, suspected bacterial or neoplastic pericarditis, or a symptomatic moderate-to-large effusion despite medical therapy, and cardiac MRI is recommended (class I) when suspected pericarditis cannot be confirmed on clinical criteria, to look for pericardial thickening, oedema and late gadolinium enhancement. Follow-up rests on symptoms, focused echo for size and haemodynamics, and CRP; if he has no symptoms, review about every 6 months for an effusion of at least moderate size, ideally in a specialised centre, with advice to return for breathlessness, fatigue or chest pain.

text.zh-CN: 中等量积液加摩擦音，孩子随时可能突然压塞：今天就在超声引导下心包穿刺，尽量抽干，积液送细胞计数、培养和细胞学检查，留置引流管到引流量很少再拔。
text.en: A moderate effusion with a rub can tamponade a child without warning: echo-guided pericardiocentesis today, drain it as fully as possible, send the fluid for cell count, culture and cytology, and keep a drain in until the output is low.

feedback.zh-CN: 没有引流指征：没有任何记录能确立心脏压塞——他没有颈静脉怒张，没有记录到血流动力学受影响，超声心动图报告也没有提到任何压塞表现（左室收缩功能正常既不能说明有压塞，也不能排除压塞）。ESC 2025推荐心包穿刺的情况是心脏压塞、怀疑细菌性或肿瘤性心包炎，或经药物治疗仍有症状的中到大量积液；这些在他身上都没有确立，宜保守处理并用超声随访，穿刺本身有心肌损伤、气胸和感染的风险。
feedback.en: No indication for drainage: nothing recorded establishes tamponade — his neck veins are not distended, no haemodynamic compromise is recorded and the echocardiogram report names no sign of tamponade (normal left ventricular systolic function neither shows nor excludes it). ESC 2025 recommends pericardiocentesis for tamponade, suspected bacterial or neoplastic pericarditis, or a symptomatic moderate-to-large effusion despite medical therapy; none of these is established for him, so conservative care with echo follow-up is preferred, and the procedure itself risks myocardial injury, pneumothorax and infection.

text.zh-CN: 按急性心包炎治疗三个月：按体重给大剂量布洛芬加秋水仙碱，限制剧烈运动，积液吸收后再逐渐减量停药。
text.en: Treat it as acute pericarditis for three months: high-dose ibuprofen plus colchicine by weight, no strenuous exercise, and a slow taper once the effusion has gone.

feedback.zh-CN: 没有心包炎症（CRP不高、影像上也没有炎症）时，ESC 2025不推荐抗炎治疗，而是针对病因处理。对原因未明的积液开几个月NSAID和秋水仙碱，带来胃肠和肾脏风险，却没有可以期待的获益。
feedback.en: Without pericardial inflammation — no raised CRP and none on imaging — ESC 2025 does not recommend anti-inflammatory treatment and asks for the cause to be treated. Months of NSAID and colchicine for an effusion of unknown cause bring gastrointestinal and renal risks without an expected benefit.

text.zh-CN: 口服泼尼松龙让积液尽快吸收，四周内逐渐减量；同时每周复查一次超声心动图，直到积液完全消失为止。
text.en: Oral prednisolone to clear the effusion quickly, tapered over four weeks, with a weekly echocardiogram until the effusion has completely gone.

feedback.zh-CN: 激素不是心包积液的一线治疗，在儿童更要严格限制（ESC 2025：生长受损等副作用）；没有心包炎症证据时，ESC 2025根本不推荐抗炎治疗。激素还会掩盖积液的病因。
feedback.en: Steroids are not first-line for a pericardial effusion and are restricted even more in children (ESC 2025: growth impairment and other side effects); without evidence of pericardial inflammation, ESC 2025 does not recommend anti-inflammatory treatment at all. Steroids also mask the effusion's cause.

text.zh-CN: 左室收缩功能正常，积液只是中等量，心脏没有需要随访的问题：积液不用再管，出院以后只随访关节。
text.en: Normal left ventricular systolic function and only a moderate effusion: there is no heart problem to follow — leave the effusion alone and follow only his joints after discharge.

feedback.zh-CN: 中等量积液需要随访：ESC 2025建议至少中等量、无症状的积液约每6个月随访一次，最好在专科中心，并告诉家属出现气短、乏力或胸痛时就诊。压塞是“最后一滴”现象，积液可能慢慢增多。
feedback.en: A moderate effusion needs follow-up: ESC 2025 suggests review about every 6 months for an asymptomatic effusion of at least moderate size, ideally in a specialised centre, with advice to return for breathlessness, fatigue or chest pain. Tamponade is a last-drop phenomenon, and an effusion can slowly grow.

prompt.zh-CN: 三年来无痛的关节肿胀逐年加重；除拇指和拇趾外，各手指、脚趾屈曲。血沉、CRP、类风湿因子和多项自身抗体反复阴性，肝肾功能和铁蛋白正常；影像见手足骨质稀疏、膝肘软组织肿胀、膝关节及髌上囊积液；另有中等量心包积液。你怎么看他的关节病？
prompt.en: Three years of painless joint swelling, worse every year; the fingers and toes other than the thumbs and great toes are flexed. ESR, CRP, rheumatoid factor and multiple autoantibodies were repeatedly negative, with normal liver and renal function and ferritin; imaging shows osteopenia of the hands and feet, soft-tissue swelling at the knees and elbows and knee and suprapatellar effusion; and there is a moderate pericardial effusion. How do you read his joint disease?

need.zh-CN: 先看血液检查记录、关节影像和超声心动图。
need.en: Read the blood test records, the joint imaging and the echocardiogram first.

text.zh-CN: 非炎症性的遗传性关节病，首先考虑CACP综合征：无痛肿胀、屈曲指、炎症和抗体检查阴性，加上心包积液；排除它之后才谈得上JIA——查髋关节和PRG4基因。
text.en: A non-inflammatory genetic arthropathy, CACP syndrome first: painless swelling, camptodactyly, negative inflammatory and antibody tests and a pericardial effusion; JIA only once that is excluded — image the hips, test PRG4.

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。按ILAR分类标准（2001年埃德蒙顿修订、2004年发表），JIA是16岁前起病、持续至少6周、病因不明的关节炎，并且要先排除其他已知疾病。无痛的肿胀、无发热皮疹、炎症和抗体检查反复阴性、屈曲指，再加心包积液，组成了CACP综合征（屈曲指—关节病—髋内翻—心包炎）的表型。Offiah等（2005）建议，凡是非炎症性关节病或“不典型JIA”都要想到CACP；在22例患儿的队列中，多数转诊时的诊断是JIA（Albuhairan等，2013）。下一步用骨盆（髋关节）X线片和PRG4基因检测来证实。
feedback.en: Right. Under the ILAR classification (Edmonton revision 2001, published 2004), JIA is arthritis of unknown cause starting before 16 and lasting at least six weeks, after other known conditions are excluded. Painless swelling without fever or rash, repeatedly negative inflammatory and antibody tests and camptodactyly, together with a pericardial effusion, make up the phenotype of CACP syndrome (camptodactyly–arthropathy–coxa vara–pericarditis). Offiah et al. (2005) advise considering CACP in any non-inflammatory arthropathy or "atypical JIA", and in a cohort of 22 children JIA was the referral diagnosis in most (Albuhairan et al., 2013). A pelvic (hip) radiograph and PRG4 testing come next to confirm it.

text.zh-CN: 类风湿因子阴性的多关节型JIA：16岁前起病、五个以上关节受累、类风湿因子阴性，炎症指标正常在JIA里并不少见；指趾屈曲是长期关节炎造成的挛缩，开始用甲氨蝶呤。
text.en: Rheumatoid-factor-negative polyarticular JIA: onset before 16, five or more joints, a negative RF, and normal markers are common in JIA; the flexed fingers and toes are contractures from long-standing arthritis — start methotrexate.

feedback.zh-CN: ILAR（2001年修订、2004年发表）把JIA定义为病因不明的关节炎，并要求先排除其他已知病因。他的肿胀无痛、无发热和皮疹，炎症和抗体检查反复阴性，还有心包积液——这些指向必须先排除的非炎症性病因；炎症指标正常本身不能证明是JIA，按JIA用甲氨蝶呤也不会有获益。
feedback.en: ILAR (revised 2001, published 2004) defines JIA as arthritis of unknown cause, once other known causes have been excluded. Painless swelling without fever or rash, repeatedly negative inflammatory and antibody tests and a pericardial effusion point to a non-inflammatory cause that must be excluded first; normal markers do not make it JIA, and methotrexate given as for JIA would bring no benefit.

text.zh-CN: 全身型JIA：多关节肿胀伴心包积液（浆膜炎）；全身型的发热可以是间断的、家属容易忽略，开始足量激素，之后再考虑IL-1或IL-6抑制剂。
text.en: Systemic JIA: polyarthritis with a pericardial effusion as serositis; its fever can be intermittent and easily missed at home, so start full-dose steroids, then consider an IL-1 or IL-6 inhibitor.

feedback.zh-CN: 全身型JIA要求关节炎伴有（或之前有）持续至少两周、至少3天记录为每日发作的发热，并有一过性皮疹、全身淋巴结肿大、肝脾大或浆膜炎之一（ILAR 2004）；他没有发热和皮疹，血沉和CRP反复阴性，铁蛋白正常，而全身型通常伴有炎症指标和铁蛋白升高。
feedback.en: Systemic JIA needs arthritis with, or preceded by, fever of at least two weeks, documented as daily for at least three days, plus one of an evanescent rash, generalised lymph node enlargement, hepatomegaly or splenomegaly, or serositis (ILAR 2004); he has no fever or rash, his ESR and CRP were repeatedly negative and his ferritin is normal, whereas systemic JIA usually raises inflammatory markers and ferritin.

text.zh-CN: 没有活动性疾病：炎症和抗体检查都是阴性，说明肿胀和屈曲是以前留下的陈旧改变；不需要再做检查，出院后常规随访即可。
text.en: No active disease: with the inflammatory and antibody tests all negative, the swelling and flexion are old changes — no further tests are needed, and routine follow-up after discharge will do.

feedback.zh-CN: 检查阴性不等于没有病：肿胀逐年加重、关节活动受限、影像上有积液和骨质稀疏，还有心包积液，都是真实的疾病证据。需要的是找出非炎症性的病因，而不是停止评估。
feedback.en: Negative tests are not the absence of disease: swelling that worsens every year, restricted joints, effusions and osteopenia on imaging and a pericardial effusion are real evidence of disease. The task is to find the non-inflammatory cause, not to stop looking.

prompt.zh-CN: 团队作出CACP综合征的临床诊断，没有PRG4基因结果，也没有髋内翻的明确测量。他的父母不是近亲，家里没人得过类似的病。家属问：这是遗传的吗？家里以后的孩子会不会也这样？你怎么回答、怎么安排？
prompt.en: The team makes a clinical diagnosis of CACP syndrome, with no PRG4 result and no explicit measurement of coxa vara. His parents are not related, and nobody in the family has had a similar illness. His relative asks whether it is inherited and whether future children in the family could have it. What do you say and arrange?

text.zh-CN: 常染色体隐性遗传，父母不是近亲、家里没人得病都不矛盾：安排遗传咨询和PRG4检测，再检测父母；父母都携带时，每个孩子有1/4的机会患病。
text.en: Autosomal recessive, which unrelated parents and a clear family history do not contradict: arrange counselling and PRG4 testing, then test his parents; if both carry a variant, each child has a 1 in 4 chance.

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。CACP由PRG4（编码润滑素；1999年发现时称为CACP基因）的双等位致病变异引起，呈常染色体隐性遗传（Marcelino等，1999）；隐性病常常没有家族史，非近亲父母的孩子也可以是复合杂合子。变异按ACMG/AMP 2015标准判读，检测父母可以确认两个变异是否分别来自父母双方。基因确诊能结束诊断上的反复，避免误用免疫抑制治疗，也让家庭得到准确的再发风险。
feedback.en: Right. CACP is caused by biallelic disease-causing variants in PRG4 (which encodes lubricin; named the CACP gene when it was found) and is autosomal recessive (Marcelino et al., 1999); recessive disorders often have no family history, and a child of unrelated parents can be a compound heterozygote. Variants are classified with the ACMG/AMP 2015 standards, and testing the parents shows whether one variant came from each. A molecular diagnosis ends the diagnostic uncertainty, guards against needless immunosuppression and gives the family an accurate recurrence risk.

text.zh-CN: 父母不是近亲、家里也没人得病，说明是他自己新发生的突变：家里以后的孩子没有风险，基因检测也就不必做了，告诉家属可以放心。
text.en: Unrelated parents and no affected relatives show it is a new (de novo) mutation in him: future children in the family are not at risk, so gene testing is unnecessary and the family can be reassured.

feedback.zh-CN: 没有家系的分子结果，就不能断定是新发突变。CACP是常染色体隐性遗传：携带者父母通常健康、没有家族史，非近亲父母也可能各带一个变异（复合杂合）。如果父母都是携带者，以后每个孩子都有1/4的机会患病。
feedback.en: Without molecular results in the family, a de novo change cannot be claimed. CACP is autosomal recessive: carrier parents are usually healthy with no family history, and unrelated parents can each carry a variant (compound heterozygosity). If both are carriers, each future child has a 1 in 4 chance.

text.zh-CN: 这类病多为常染色体显性遗传、轻重差别很大：父母中可能有一位症状很轻、自己没发现，每个孩子有1/2的机会；先仔细检查父母的手和关节，不必给他做基因检测。
text.en: These conditions are usually autosomal dominant with very variable severity: a parent may be mildly affected and unaware, so each child has a 1 in 2 chance — examine the parents' hands and joints instead of testing him.

feedback.zh-CN: CACP是常染色体隐性遗传，不是显性；携带者父母没有表现，检查父母的手回答不了这个问题。应先给他做PRG4检测证实诊断，再检测父母，确认携带状态。
feedback.en: CACP is autosomal recessive, not dominant; carrier parents have no signs, so examining their hands cannot answer the question. Test him for PRG4 first to confirm the diagnosis, then test his parents for carrier status.

text.zh-CN: 男孩患病、家里又没人有类似的病，最可能是母亲携带的X连锁隐性遗传：以后的男孩有1/2的机会患病，女孩不会患病，所以只需检测母亲。
text.en: An affected boy with no similar illness in the family points to X-linked recessive inheritance carried by his mother: future boys have a 1 in 2 chance and girls will not be affected, so only his mother needs testing.

feedback.zh-CN: CACP的致病基因PRG4位于1号染色体，是常染色体隐性遗传，男孩女孩都可以患病；如果父母都是携带者，以后的孩子不论男女，每个都有1/4的机会患病。
feedback.en: PRG4, the gene behind CACP, lies on chromosome 1: inheritance is autosomal recessive and boys and girls are affected alike; if both parents are carriers, each future child, boy or girl, has a 1 in 4 chance.

text.zh-CN: 临床表现已足够诊断，基因结果也不会改变他的治疗：不必做基因检测；告诉家属家里没有人得过这种病，以后再发生的风险很低。
text.en: The clinical picture is diagnostic and a gene result would not change his treatment: skip gene testing, and tell the family that the risk of it happening again is low because no one else has had it.

feedback.zh-CN: 临床诊断只停留在表型层面，CACP被误诊为JIA很常见（Albuhairan等，2013；Kisla Ekinci等，2021）。基因确诊能避免误用免疫抑制药、结束反复的检查，并给家庭准确的再发风险（父母都携带时为1/4）；没有家族史不代表风险低。
feedback.en: A clinical diagnosis rests on the phenotype alone, and CACP is often misdiagnosed as JIA (Albuhairan et al., 2013; Kisla Ekinci et al., 2021). Genetic confirmation protects him from needless immunosuppression, ends repeated testing and gives the family an accurate recurrence risk (1 in 4 if both parents carry a variant); no family history does not mean a low risk.

prompt.zh-CN: 家属问：他的关节该用什么药？以后会怎么样？请为他的关节制订计划。
prompt.en: His relative asks which medicines will help his joints and what lies ahead. Make the plan for his joints.

text.zh-CN: 不用激素、甲氨蝶呤或生物制剂，因为没有可治疗的炎症；做物理治疗和作业治疗，拍骨盆片并由骨科随访髋关节，与心脏科共同定期复查。
text.en: No steroid, methotrexate or biologic, as there is no inflammation to treat; physiotherapy and occupational therapy, a pelvic radiograph with orthopaedic follow-up of the hips, and review shared with cardiology.

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。CACP是缺乏润滑素（PRG4蛋白）造成的非炎症性关节病；在一个3例的病例系列中，先按JIA治疗的2例患儿用甲氨蝶呤加TNF抑制剂（其中1例还用了关节腔激素）都没有效果（Kisla Ekinci等，2021）。目前没有针对CACP的指南，保持关节功能主要靠康复——2026年ACR JIA指南同样有条件地推荐物理治疗、作业治疗和体力活动，不论是否用药——再加上髋关节影像和骨科、心脏科的随访；髋部病变可能随时间进展（Bahabri等，1998）。
feedback.en: Right. CACP is a non-inflammatory arthropathy caused by lack of lubricin (the PRG4 protein); in a three-patient series, the two children first treated as JIA did not respond to methotrexate with a TNF inhibitor, one of them also given intra-articular steroid (Kisla Ekinci et al., 2021). There is no CACP guideline: function is kept mainly by rehabilitation — the 2026 ACR JIA guidelines likewise conditionally recommend physical and occupational therapy, and physical activity, whatever the drug treatment — with hip imaging and orthopaedic and cardiac follow-up, since hip disease may progress over time (Bahabri et al., 1998).

text.zh-CN: 按多关节型JIA达标治疗：现在开始每周一次甲氨蝶呤，三个月后肿胀还不消退就加用TNF抑制剂，其间用膝、踝关节腔内注射激素作过渡。
text.en: Treat to target as polyarticular JIA: weekly methotrexate now, adding a TNF inhibitor if the swelling has not settled by three months, with intra-articular steroid into the knees and ankles as a bridge in the meantime.

feedback.zh-CN: 这是多关节型JIA的路径（2026年ACR JIA指南），但他的关节病不是炎症性的。先按JIA治疗的CACP患儿用甲氨蝶呤加TNF抑制剂都没有效果（Kisla Ekinci等，2021），却要承担肝毒性、感染和反复镇静注射的风险。
feedback.en: That is the polyarticular JIA pathway (2026 ACR JIA guidelines), but his arthropathy is not inflammatory. Children with CACP first treated as JIA did not respond to methotrexate with a TNF inhibitor (Kisla Ekinci et al., 2021), and they bring liver toxicity, infection and repeated sedated injections.

text.zh-CN: 肿胀范围广、已经持续三年，用长期口服泼尼松龙控制肿胀，等关节消肿后再非常缓慢地减量，同时补钙和维生素D来保护骨骼。
text.en: Widespread swelling for three years: long-term oral prednisolone to control it, tapered very slowly once the joints settle, with calcium and vitamin D to protect his bones.

feedback.zh-CN: 没有可治疗的炎症，激素改善不了非炎症性关节病；长期激素会抑制生长、加重骨质稀疏（他的手足已有骨质稀疏）、增加感染风险。即使是确诊的多关节型JIA，2026年ACR JIA指南也有条件地不建议把口服激素作为初始治疗的辅助用药；对长期口服或静脉用激素的JIA患者，指南强烈建议每年至少两次监测生长、每年至少一次评估骨骼健康。
feedback.en: With no inflammation to treat, steroids cannot help a non-inflammatory arthropathy; long-term steroids stunt growth, worsen osteopenia (his hands and feet already show it) and raise infection risk. Even for established polyarticular JIA, the 2026 ACR JIA guidelines conditionally recommend against oral glucocorticoids as an adjunct to initial therapy, and for people with JIA on chronic oral or intravenous glucocorticoids they strongly recommend checking growth at least twice a year and bone health at least once a year.

text.zh-CN: 这是遗传病，没有药物能治，锻炼也改变不了：不需要康复，也不必定期随访，等他长大以后真出了问题再处理。
text.en: It is genetic, no medicine treats it and exercise will not change it: no rehabilitation and no regular follow-up — deal with problems as they arise when he is older.

feedback.zh-CN: 没有药能逆转，不等于无事可做。康复是保持关节活动度和日常功能的主要手段（2026年ACR JIA指南有条件地推荐物理治疗和作业治疗，CACP没有专门指南）；髋关节需要影像和骨科随访，中等量心包积液需要心脏科定期随访（ESC 2025）。
feedback.en: No drug reverses it, but that is not nothing to do. Rehabilitation is the main way to keep range of motion and daily function (the 2026 ACR JIA guidelines conditionally recommend physical and occupational therapy; CACP has no guideline of its own); his hips need imaging and orthopaedic follow-up, and the moderate pericardial effusion needs regular cardiology review (ESC 2025).

text.zh-CN: 问清三年的经过：肿胀的起病和加重、疼不疼、发热皮疹、以前的检查和治疗、家族史和父母是否近亲，也问了手指何时开始弯曲和有无心脏症状
text.en: Took the three-year story — onset and progression, pain, fever or rash, earlier tests and treatment, family history and consanguinity — and asked when the fingers began to bend and about heart symptoms

text.zh-CN: 查看手指脚趾和四肢大关节，听诊心脏并看颈静脉
text.en: Examined the fingers, toes and large limb joints, listened to the heart and looked at the neck veins

text.zh-CN: 入院当天就申请了超声心动图
text.en: Requested echocardiography on the day of admission

text.zh-CN: 入院当天在床旁评估有无心脏压塞并安排定时复查
text.en: Checked for tamponade at the bedside on the day of admission and arranged repeat checks

text.zh-CN: 入院当天对心脏的处理第一次即答对
text.en: Planned the heart's first-day care correctly at the first attempt

text.zh-CN: 调阅炎症指标、抗体、肝肾功能与铁蛋白记录和关节影像
text.en: Read the inflammatory-marker, antibody, organ-function and ferritin records and the joint imaging

text.zh-CN: 心包积液的下一步计划第一次即答对
text.en: Chose the next steps for the pericardial effusion correctly at the first attempt

text.zh-CN: 第一次就把关节病判读为非炎症性、并说明JIA是排除性诊断
text.en: Read the joint disease as non-inflammatory, with JIA a diagnosis of exclusion, at the first attempt

text.zh-CN: 为证实诊断申请了骨盆（髋关节）X线片和基因检测
text.en: Ordered a pelvic (hip) radiograph and a gene test to confirm the diagnosis

text.zh-CN: 遗传方式、再发风险和检测安排第一次即答对
text.en: Explained the inheritance, recurrence risk and testing plan correctly at the first attempt

text.zh-CN: 关节的长期计划第一次即答对
text.en: Made the long-term plan for his joints correctly at the first attempt

text.zh-CN: 请心脏科、康复、遗传科和骨科共同参与
text.en: Brought in cardiology, rehabilitation, clinical genetics and orthopaedics

text.zh-CN: 没有在无指征时做心包穿刺引流
text.en: Did not put a needle into the pericardium without an indication

text.zh-CN: 没有在炎症未确立时使用激素、甲氨蝶呤、生物制剂、关节腔注射或NSAID（或阿司匹林）加秋水仙碱
text.en: Gave no steroid, methotrexate, biologic, joint injection or NSAID (or aspirin) with colchicine while no inflammation was established

text.zh-CN: 和清和及家属谈：说明工作诊断、还没证实的部分和计划，回应对激素的担心，用复述法核实理解
text.en: Talked with Qinghe and his relative: the working diagnosis, what is not yet proven and the plan, the worry about steroids, and teach-back

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 优秀表现（Calgary–Cambridge）：先问家属知道什么、最担心什么（三年来查血沉、查风湿都阴性却越来越重；怕用激素）；用通俗的话解释：肿胀不是常见的那种“风湿”炎症，抗炎药和激素帮不上忙；心脏外面有一层积液，要请心脏科评估并定期复查；告诉家属诊断（用SPIKES：先了解他们的认识，询问想知道多少，再分步告知），说清楚这是根据表现作出的诊断，还需要基因检测来证实，结果对家里以后的孩子也有意义；回答“会不会遗传”时不作没有根据的保证；对9岁的孩子用他能听懂的话说明锻炼的作用；最后请家属用自己的话复述计划（复述法），并告诉他们出现气短、乏力或胸痛时要马上就诊。原报告没有记录与家属的谈话。
judgeGuidance.en: Good performance (Calgary–Cambridge): start from what the relative knows and fears most (three years of negative ESR and rheumatism tests yet worse every year; a fear of steroids); explain in plain words that the swelling is not the usual inflammatory “rheumatism”, so anti-inflammatory drugs and steroids will not help; that there is fluid around the heart, which the heart team will assess and recheck; give the diagnosis with SPIKES (their understanding first, how much they want to know, then step by step), making clear it rests on his features and needs a gene test to confirm it, which also matters for future children in the family; no unfounded reassurance about inheritance; explain to the 9-year-old, in words he can follow, why the exercises matter; close with teach-back and tell them to come back at once for breathlessness, tiredness or chest pain. The report records no conversation with the family.

name.zh-CN: 带教老师（儿科主治医师）

knowledge.zh-CN: 这是一份历史病例的教学回看，按入院当天、检查结果、诊断与长期计划、原报告的处理与随访四步推进。用苏格拉底式提问，不提前说出诊断、原报告的处理或随访结果；复盘用PEARLS（反应、描述、分析、总结）。可以讨论的病例事实只限于学员已经得到的：9岁男孩，体重19.5 kg，身高没有记录，判断生长要把体重和身高画在生长曲线上；三年前发现四肢多处关节肿胀、逐年加重，不疼，没有发热和皮疹；入院查体有心音稍钝和心包摩擦音，无颈静脉怒张。他的心率、血压、呼吸、体温、手指脚趾何时开始弯曲、有无胸痛气短都没有记录，不要替它补上。引导顺序：先处理心脏（床旁评估压塞、超声心动图和心电图等初始评估，ESC 2025），再区分炎症性与非炎症性关节病（按ILAR 2004，JIA只有在排除其他已知疾病后才能诊断），然后找一个能同时解释关节、手指和心包的原因，最后讨论分子诊断、遗传咨询和不用免疫抑制的长期计划。
knowledge.en: A historical case reviewed for teaching, in four steps: the day of admission, the results, the diagnosis and long-term plan, then the report's treatment and follow-up. Teach by Socratic questions; never reveal the diagnosis, the report's management or the follow-up early; debrief with PEARLS (reactions, description, analysis, summary). Discuss only facts the learner already has: a 9-year-old boy weighing 19.5 kg whose height is not recorded (plot weight and height on a growth chart before judging growth); swelling of several limb joints noticed three years ago and worse every year, painless, without fever or rash; on admission slightly muffled heart sounds with a pericardial rub and no jugular venous distension. His heart rate, blood pressure, breathing, temperature, when his fingers and toes began to bend and any chest pain or breathlessness are not recorded — never supply them. Order of teaching: the heart first (bedside tamponade check and the initial assessment with echocardiography and ECG, ESC 2025); then inflammatory versus non-inflammatory joint disease (ILAR 2004: JIA only once other known conditions are excluded); then one cause that would explain the joints, the fingers and the pericardium together; finally molecular confirmation, genetic counselling and a long-term plan without immunosuppression.

name.zh-CN: 儿科病房护士

knowledge.zh-CN: 负责清和的儿科病房护士，交班用ISBAR：I——陈清和，9岁男孩，家属陪同入院；S——四肢多处关节肿胀三年，一年比一年重；B——家属说以前查过血沉和风湿方面的指标，都是阴性，没有做过特别的治疗；体重19.5 kg；A——他的心率、血压、呼吸和体温还没有记在病历上，如果医生要求，可以去床旁测量，包括测奇脉，但不能报出病历上没有的数值；R——请医生先问病史、给他查体。可以协助：床旁生命体征和奇脉、做心电图、联系超声心动图、胸片和抽血、请会诊和康复科。
knowledge.en: Qinghe's nurse on the children's ward, handing over by ISBAR: I — Chen Qinghe, a 9-year-old boy admitted with a relative; S — swelling of several limb joints for three years, worse every year; B — the relative says earlier ESR and rheumatism tests were negative and he has had no particular treatment; weight 19.5 kg; A — his heart rate, blood pressure, breathing and temperature are not yet in his notes; she can measure them at the bedside when asked, pulsus paradoxus included, but never quotes values the notes do not hold; R — please take the history and examine him first. Can help with bedside observations and pulsus paradoxus, the ECG, arranging echocardiography, a chest X-ray and blood tests, and calling consultants and the rehabilitation team.

name.zh-CN: 儿童心脏科医生

knowledge.zh-CN: 被请会诊时到场。依据ESC 2025心肌炎和心包炎指南：怀疑心包炎时，初始评估包括病史、查体、胸片、生物标志物、心电图和超声心动图（I类）；心包摩擦音是心包炎的附加标准之一，确诊要有临床表现（如胸痛）并符合超过一项（即至少两项）附加标准；怀疑心包炎而临床标准不能确诊时，推荐做心脏磁共振（I类），评估心包增厚、水肿和延迟强化。心脏压塞是临床诊断，由超声心动图证实；积液缓慢积聚时Beck三联征可以缺如；奇脉是吸气时收缩压下降至少10 mmHg；压塞是“最后一滴”现象。积液应尽量针对病因治疗；没有心包炎症（既没有CRP升高，影像也没有炎症证据）时不推荐抗炎治疗。心包穿刺（超声、CT或X线透视引导）推荐用于心脏压塞、怀疑细菌性或肿瘤性心包炎，或经药物治疗仍有症状的中到大量积液（I类）。无症状、至少中等量的积液，合理的随访约每6个月一次，最好在专科中心，出现气短、乏力或胸痛要及时就诊。儿童更要严格限制激素（生长受损）。学员拿到超声心动图结果后才解读；该记录没有积液深度、分布或压塞的超声表现。
knowledge.en: Comes when asked to review. From the ESC 2025 myocarditis and pericarditis guidelines: suspected pericarditis needs an initial assessment with history, examination, chest X-ray, biomarkers, ECG and echocardiography (class I); a pericardial rub is one additional criterion, and a definite diagnosis needs a clinical presentation (such as chest pain) with more than one additional criterion; cardiac MRI is recommended (class I) in suspected pericarditis when clinical criteria cannot make the diagnosis, to look for pericardial thickening, oedema and late gadolinium enhancement. Tamponade is a clinical diagnosis confirmed by echocardiography; Beck's triad may be missing when fluid gathers slowly; pulsus paradoxus is an inspiratory fall in systolic pressure of at least 10 mmHg; tamponade is a last-drop phenomenon. Treat an effusion's cause wherever possible; without pericardial inflammation (no raised CRP and no imaging evidence) anti-inflammatory treatment is not recommended. Pericardiocentesis (echocardiography-, CT- or fluoroscopy-guided) is recommended for tamponade, suspected bacterial or neoplastic pericarditis, or a symptomatic moderate-to-large effusion despite medical therapy (class I). For an asymptomatic effusion of at least moderate size a reasonable follow-up is about every 6 months, ideally in a specialised centre, with advice to return for breathlessness, fatigue or chest pain. Corticosteroids are restricted in children even more than in adults (growth impairment). Interprets the echocardiogram only once the learner has read it; its record gives no effusion depth, distribution or echocardiographic signs of tamponade.

name.zh-CN: 临床遗传科医生

knowledge.zh-CN: 被请会诊时到场，只讲方法和原则，不替团队下诊断。说明怎样选检测（单基因、基因包或外显子组）、检测能说明什么和不能说明什么（变异按ACMG/AMP 2015标准分为致病、可能致病、意义不明、可能良性和良性）；常染色体隐性遗传时，携带者父母通常健康、家里常常没有类似的人，父母不是近亲也可以各带一个变异；父母都是携带者时，每个孩子有1/4的机会患病；找到孩子的变异后检测父母，确认两个变异是否分别来自父母双方；检测前后都要做遗传咨询并取得同意。本病例没有记录这个孩子的任何基因检测结果，也没有记录遗传咨询。
knowledge.en: Comes when asked to review and talks about methods and principles only, never making the team's diagnosis. Explains how a test is chosen (a single gene, a panel or an exome), what a result can and cannot show (variants classed under the ACMG/AMP 2015 standards as pathogenic, likely pathogenic, of uncertain significance, likely benign or benign); that in autosomal recessive inheritance carrier parents are usually well, there is often nobody similar in the family, and unrelated parents can each carry a variant; that when both parents carry one, each child has a 1 in 4 chance of being affected; that once the child's variants are found the parents are tested to see whether one came from each; and that counselling and consent come before and after testing. No gene-test result of any kind and no genetic counselling are recorded for this boy.

title.zh-CN: 复盘：无痛的关节肿胀、屈曲的手指和心包积液
title.en: Debrief: painless swollen joints, bent fingers and a pericardial effusion

conclusion.zh-CN: 陈清和9岁，体重19.5 kg。三年前发现他四肢多处关节肿胀，一年比一年重；不疼，没有发热和皮疹，早期活动还不明显受限；以前查过血沉和风湿相关指标，均为阴性，没有做过特殊治疗；父母非近亲结婚，家族中没有类似疾病。查体：除拇指和拇趾外各指趾屈曲，肘、膝屈伸受限，肘、膝、踝、腕肿胀畸形；心音稍钝，心前区可闻心包摩擦音，无颈静脉怒张。血沉、CRP、类风湿因子和多项自身抗体反复阴性，肝肾功能和铁蛋白正常；影像见手足骨质稀疏、膝肘软组织肿胀、膝关节及髌上囊积液；超声心动图示中等量心包积液，左室收缩功能正常。团队临床诊断为CACP综合征，没有PRG4基因结果，也没有髋内翻的明确测量；未用特殊药物，建议功能锻炼；随访时关节畸形没有明显改善，随访时长未记录。今天的做法：入院当天就在床旁评估压塞、完成超声心动图等初始评估；把无痛的肿胀、屈曲指和反复阴性的炎症检查读作非炎症性关节病，而不是JIA；不用激素、甲氨蝶呤或生物制剂，也不做没有指征的心包穿刺；用PRG4检测和遗传咨询证实诊断，拍骨盆片评估髋关节，并由康复、骨科和心脏科共同随访。
conclusion.en: Chen Qinghe, 9 years old and 19.5 kg, had swelling of several limb joints first noticed three years earlier and worse every year: painless, without fever or rash, and at first his movement was not clearly restricted. Earlier ESR and rheumatism tests had been negative, he had had no specific treatment, his parents are not consanguineous and no similar illness was reported in the family. The fingers and toes other than the thumbs and great toes were flexed, elbow and knee movement was restricted, and the elbows, knees, ankles and wrists were swollen and deformed; his heart sounds were slightly muffled, with a precordial pericardial rub and no jugular venous distension. ESR, CRP, RF and multiple autoantibodies were repeatedly negative and liver and renal function and ferritin normal; imaging showed osteopenia of the hands and feet, soft-tissue swelling at the knees and elbows and knee and suprapatellar effusion; echocardiography showed a moderate pericardial effusion with normal left ventricular systolic function. The team diagnosed CACP syndrome clinically, without a PRG4 result or an explicit measurement of coxa vara, gave no specific medication and advised functional exercise; at a follow-up of unrecorded length the deformities had not clearly improved. Today's care: check for tamponade at the bedside and complete the initial assessment with echocardiography on the day of admission; read painless swelling, camptodactyly and repeatedly negative inflammatory tests as a non-inflammatory arthropathy rather than JIA; give no steroid, methotrexate or biologic and no needle without an indication; and confirm the diagnosis with PRG4 testing and genetic counselling, a pelvic radiograph for the hips, and shared rehabilitation, orthopaedic and cardiology follow-up.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 心音稍钝加心包摩擦音说明心包受累：先在床旁判断有无压塞，再给积液成像，然后才决定别的事。
keyReasoning.en: Slightly muffled heart sounds with a rub mean the pericardium is involved: judge tamponade at the bedside and image the effusion before deciding anything else.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 三年无痛的肿胀逐年加重，没有发热皮疹，血沉、CRP、类风湿因子和自身抗体反复阴性——这些都不支持炎症性关节炎；JIA是排除性诊断。
keyReasoning.en: Three years of painless swelling, worse each year, without fever or rash, and repeatedly negative ESR, CRP, RF and autoantibodies all argue against an inflammatory arthritis — and JIA is a diagnosis of exclusion.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 除拇指、拇趾外的指趾屈曲是要说出名字的体征，不能简单归为陈旧关节炎留下的挛缩。
keyReasoning.en: Flexed fingers and toes that spare the thumbs and great toes are a sign to name, not to explain away as old arthritic contractures.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 既未确立压塞、也未确立心包炎症的中等量积液（摩擦音只是一项标准，不等于诊断；他的CRP不高），要观察、做心脏磁共振并找原因，而不是引流或抗炎治疗。
keyReasoning.en: A moderate effusion in which neither tamponade nor pericardial inflammation is established — a rub is one criterion, not a diagnosis, and his CRP is not raised — is watched, imaged with cardiac MRI and its cause sought: not drained, not treated with anti-inflammatories.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 关节、手指和心包放在一起，指向一个遗传病（CACP）；临床诊断还需要分子诊断和遗传咨询来证实。
keyReasoning.en: Joints, fingers and pericardium together point to one genetic disorder (CACP); a clinical label needs molecular confirmation and genetic counselling.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 治疗靠康复、骨科和心脏科随访，不靠免疫抑制：原报告不用特殊药物、建议功能锻炼，与今天的做法一致。
keyReasoning.en: Care is rehabilitation with orthopaedic and cardiac follow-up, not immunosuppression: the report's choice of no specific drug and functional exercise matches today's approach.

boundaries.zh-CN: 这是单个病例报告，不能说明CACP的一般病程，也不能说明任何治疗的效果。原报告的处理作为历史事实保留；决策、处置选项和评分依据现行指南设计，是教学设计。本病例没有记录生命体征、身高、积液的毫米数、髋关节测量、基因检测结果和随访时长，这些都保持未知。
boundaries.en: A single case report cannot show how CACP usually behaves or how well any treatment works. The report's management is kept as historical fact; the decisions, management options and scoring follow current guidance and are teaching design. This case records no vital signs, height, effusion size in mm, hip measurement, gene result or length of follow-up; they stay unknown.

unknowns.zh-CN: 手指、脚趾从什么时候开始弯曲；有没有晨僵；身高和这几年的生长情况。
unknowns.en: When his fingers and toes began to bend; any morning stiffness; his height and growth over the years.

unknowns.zh-CN: 入院时的心率、血压、呼吸、体温和奇脉；有没有胸痛、气短或容易疲劳；心电图和胸片。
unknowns.en: His heart rate, blood pressure, breathing, temperature and pulsus paradoxus on admission; any chest pain, breathlessness or easy tiring; an ECG and a chest X-ray.

unknowns.zh-CN: 心包积液的深度、分布、有无压塞的超声表现，积液后来的变化和有没有复查超声心动图。
unknowns.en: The effusion's depth, distribution and any echocardiographic signs of tamponade; its later course and any repeat echocardiogram.

unknowns.zh-CN: 关节影像的检查方法；髋关节的影像和明确测量（如股骨颈干角）。
unknowns.en: The method of the joint imaging; imaging and an explicit measurement of the hips (such as the femoral neck–shaft angle).

unknowns.zh-CN: 有没有做过PRG4或其他基因检测和遗传咨询；有没有兄弟姐妹。
unknowns.en: Any PRG4 or other gene test and genetic counselling; whether he has brothers or sisters.

unknowns.zh-CN: 随访的时长，随访时的关节功能和日常活动。
unknowns.en: How long he was followed, and his joint function and daily activities at follow-up.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: JIA是排除性诊断（ILAR分类标准，Petty等，2004）：16岁前起病、持续至少6周、病因不明的关节炎，并且要先排除其他已知疾病；其中“关节炎”的定义本身也排除了其他可以识别的原因。CACP就是这样一个原因：Offiah等（2005）建议，凡是非炎症性关节病或“不典型JIA”都要想到CACP，骨盆片上的大髋臼囊肿在相应临床背景下可视为CACP的特征性（可据以诊断的）表现；在22例沙特患儿中，转诊诊断多数是JIA，所有患儿炎症指标正常、类风湿因子阴性（Albuhairan等，2013）。
teachingPoints.en: JIA is a diagnosis of exclusion (ILAR classification, Petty et al., 2004): arthritis of unknown cause beginning before the 16th birthday and persisting at least 6 weeks, other known conditions excluded — and its definition of arthritis itself excludes other identifiable causes. CACP is such a cause: Offiah et al. (2005) advise considering it in every non-inflammatory arthropathy or “atypical JIA”, with large acetabular cysts on pelvic radiographs regarded as pathognomonic in the right setting; among 22 Saudi children, JIA was the referral diagnosis in most, and all had normal inflammatory markers and a negative RF (Albuhairan et al., 2013).

teachingPoints.zh-CN: ESC 2025心肌炎和心包炎指南：所有怀疑心包炎的患者，初始评估包括病史、查体、胸片、生物标志物、心电图和超声心动图（I类）。心脏压塞是临床诊断、由超声心动图证实；积液缓慢积聚时Beck三联征可以缺如，奇脉是吸气时收缩压下降至少10 mmHg，压塞是“最后一滴”现象——所以他没有颈静脉怒张，不等于可以把超声心动图推到门诊。
teachingPoints.en: ESC 2025 myocarditis and pericarditis guidelines: everyone with suspected pericarditis gets an initial assessment with history, examination, chest X-ray, biomarkers, ECG and echocardiography (class I). Tamponade is a clinical diagnosis confirmed by echocardiography; Beck's triad may be missing when fluid gathers slowly, pulsus paradoxus is an inspiratory fall in systolic pressure of at least 10 mmHg, and tamponade is a last-drop phenomenon — so the absence of jugular venous distension is no reason to defer the echocardiogram to the clinic.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: ESC 2025对心包积液：尽量针对病因治疗；没有心包炎症（既没有CRP升高、影像也没有炎症证据）时不推荐抗炎治疗；怀疑心包炎而临床标准不能确诊时，推荐做心脏磁共振（I类）；心包穿刺（影像引导）推荐用于压塞、怀疑细菌性或肿瘤性心包炎，或经药物治疗仍有症状的中到大量积液（I类）；无症状、至少中等量的积液约每6个月随访一次，最好在专科中心。原报告没有记录心脏科随访或复查的超声心动图——这是今天要补上的。
teachingPoints.en: ESC 2025 on pericardial effusion: treat the cause wherever possible; without pericardial inflammation (no raised CRP and no imaging evidence) anti-inflammatory treatment is not recommended; cardiac MRI is recommended (class I) when suspected pericarditis cannot be confirmed on clinical criteria; image-guided pericardiocentesis is recommended for tamponade, suspected bacterial or neoplastic pericarditis, or a symptomatic moderate-to-large effusion despite medical therapy (class I); an asymptomatic effusion of at least moderate size is followed about every 6 months, ideally in a specialised centre. The report records no cardiology follow-up or repeat echocardiogram — today's care adds them.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: CACP是常染色体隐性遗传，由PRG4（润滑素）的双等位致病变异引起（Marcelino等，1999）。原报告是临床诊断、没有PRG4结果；今天应做基因检测（变异按ACMG/AMP 2015标准判读），再检测父母，并在检测前后做遗传咨询：父母都携带时每个孩子有1/4的机会患病；父母不是近亲、家里没有类似的人，并不能排除隐性遗传病。
teachingPoints.en: CACP is autosomal recessive, caused by biallelic disease-causing variants in PRG4, the lubricin gene (Marcelino et al., 1999). The report's diagnosis was clinical, without a PRG4 result; today a gene test (variants classed by the ACMG/AMP 2015 standards), parental testing and counselling before and after the test confirm it: when both parents carry a variant each child has a 1 in 4 chance, and unrelated parents with no affected relatives do not exclude a recessive disorder.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 治疗：没有药物被证明能改善CACP的关节病。在一个3例的病例系列中，先按JIA治疗的2例患儿用甲氨蝶呤加TNF抑制剂（其中1例还用了关节腔激素）都没有效果（Kisla Ekinci等，2021）；即使是确诊的多关节型JIA，2026年ACR JIA指南也以改善病情药为一线治疗，并有条件地不建议把口服激素作为初始治疗的辅助用药。原报告未用特殊药物、建议功能锻炼，与今天一致；同一套2026年指南有条件地推荐物理治疗、作业治疗和体力活动，不论是否同时用药；髋部病变可能随时间进展（Bahabri等，1998），所以要拍髋关节片并由骨科随访。
teachingPoints.en: Treatment: no drug has been shown to help the arthropathy of CACP. In a three-patient series, the two children first treated as JIA did not respond to methotrexate with a TNF inhibitor, one also given intra-articular steroid (Kisla Ekinci et al., 2021), and even in established polyarticular JIA the 2026 ACR JIA guidelines make DMARDs the first-line therapy and conditionally recommend against oral glucocorticoids as an adjunct to initial therapy. The report's choice — no specific medication, functional exercise — matches today's; the same 2026 guidelines conditionally recommend physical and occupational therapy, and physical activity, regardless of drug treatment, and hip disease may progress over time (Bahabri et al., 1998), so the hips are imaged and followed by orthopaedics.

unknowns.en: His heart rate, blood pressure, breathing, temperature and pulsus paradoxus on admission; any chest pain, breathlessness or easy tiring; an ECG and a chest X-ray.
